result.title: ExaTune: Exhaustive Hyperparameter Landscape Exploration at Scale
result.summary: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) returns a single optimal configuration, systematically discarding the explored performance landscape that encodes how results depend on configuration choices. Fitness landscape analysis comprises a robust collection of methods from evolutionary computation offering ruggedness indices, autocorrelation functions, and fitness-distance correlation that have never been applied to machine learning hyperparameter spaces at scale, given that fine-grained ground-truth enumeration data has not existed. We present ExaTune, an open-source HPC system to produce a new artifact class: the hyperparameter landscape map. ExaTune exhaustively evaluates every point on a discretized hyperparameter grid via $K$-fold cross-validation, aggregates results into reproducible parquet benchmarks, and applies a suite of five formalized landscape metrics: spatial autocorrelation (Moran's $I$), ruggedness, local optima density, fitness-distance correlation (FDC), and variance-based parameter importance. We release a benchmark collection of 8 complete landscape maps (totalling 285,080 exhaustively evaluated configurations) spanning five model families (SVMs, random forests, XGBoost, ridge regression, and $k$-nearest neighbors) across six classification and two regression benchmarks, hosted on HuggingFace. Empirical analysis demonstrates that Bayesian optimization, Optuna, Hyperband, and Random Search at standard trial budgets systematically miss instability regions, secondary optima, and parameter interaction effects that are visible in complete landscapes; information that is structurally unavailable to any optimizer by design.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ExaTune，一个开源 HPC 系统，对离散超参数网格做穷尽式 K 折交叉验证评估，并给出五种形式化景观指标（Moran's I 空间自相关、崎岖度、局部最优密度、适应度—距离相关、基于方差的重要性），发布 8 个完整超参数景观图基准（共 285,080 个配置），并说明常规优化器会系统性错过不稳定区域与次要最优。
AI.relevance_reason: 其穷尽枚举加景观度量的做法，可能可供核查用于刻画 LVR 中 think/look 预算、latent 长度等超参数对性能的依赖形状与不稳定区间，为长度泛化与停止决策的配置选择提供分析工具；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态。
